written: 2026-11-28, before any comparison was computed; pass bar proposed, waiting for the owner's approval (rework gate 4)
question: Does each strike's vol from LSE's smile (gexsys/smile.py rules v1) bring the OCC estimate closer to Cboe's own quotes than one VIX-family vol per expiry (occ+vix)?
privacy: LSE values are local only: inputs and per-pair results stay in %LOCALAPPDATA%/gexsys/studies/occ_lse_accuracy/; the repo, GitHub and the hosted site get this definition and, at most, the verdict words

A_iv_level.truth: Cboe-era snapshots in %LOCALAPPDATA%/gexsys/snapshots/{NQ-CBOE,ES-CBOE}/ (10-19 Nov 2026): for each market and session d, the last snapshot taken after d's close (marketcal.rth_close_dt(d) + 15 min) and before the next session's open; expected_move gives expiry E (the next session), strike K = atm_strike, price S = ref_price, time = asof, IV_cboe = atm_iv. No such snapshot: the pair is dropped and counted

arms.vix_same: gexsys/providers/occ.py curve (vol date d) at E, at the truth's time; x VXN/VIX for NDX
arms.smile_same: smile.Surface from LSE Greeks of session d at (E, K, S, time)
arms.vix_late: the curve of vol date d-1, read the same way
arms.smile_late: smile of session d-1 re-levelled by curve_d(T)/curve_{d-1}(T), as the provider does when LSE is a session late

A_iv_level.metric: error = arm IV - IV_cboe, in vol points; per pair, per day and in total: n, median |error|, mean error (bias), worst
A_iv_level.primary: paired by (market, d): D = |err smile_same| - |err vix_same|; median D with a 95% bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples, the seed above), and the count of pairs where the smile is closer
A_iv_level.secondary: the same for smile_late vs vix_late
A_iv_level.lse_needed: LSE Greeks of the sessions 9-19 Nov 2026 (the export endpoint; calls not yet budgeted: owner decision)

B_levels_on_cboe_days.result_before_running: not possible: no historical OI. OCC's series-search takes no date (it serves the latest end-of-day file only), and OCC's report pages refused an automated read with HTTP 403 on 2026-11-28; no documented free by-date options open-interest endpoint was found

C_sensitivity.sample: every session from the first one START.bat caches LSE chains for (GEX_LSE=1), NQ and ES
C_sensitivity.method: the same OCC open interest, prices and time (09:00 ET of the next session), built twice: occ+vix and occ+lse
C_sensitivity.metrics: zero gamma difference in points and in expected moves (expected_move.one_sigma_points); call and put wall: same strike, within 1 listed strike, or further; C1 and P1 the same; Pearson correlation of abs_by_strike over the union of strikes
C_sensitivity.flags: |zero gamma difference| > 0.25 expected moves, or a wall further than 1 strike: flagged and listed for review, never hidden
C_sensitivity.verdict: none: it measures how much the choice of vol moves the levels, not which is right

D_live_shadow.result_before_running: not run: needs Cboe beside OCC + LSE, and Cboe was refused (gate 1) and removed from the project at the owner's word

pass_bar_proposed.minimum_n: 8 pairs (market, d) in A's primary comparison; fewer: "can't tell (n too small)"
pass_bar_proposed.better: median D <= -0.5 vol points, its 95% interval below 0, and the smile closer in at least 70% of pairs
pass_bar_proposed.unlocks: gate 3 (a) plan and Bias and (c) a separate local track record: only on "better" in A and the owner's approval; (b) the local paste also needs B or D, which cannot run, so the paste stays held

roll_weeks: sessions inside a futures roll week (8 days before the quarterly expiry) are flagged in every table; none fall in 10-19 Nov 2026
not_tested: 0DTE (the smile gives it no vol); levels against ground truth (B and D impossible); any session after 19 Nov against Cboe
